# agentic-coding-playbook

> Federal AI agent behavioral playbook and standards. Scope: FIPS Moderate | Single-agent | Internal enterprise.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention: a curated map of the repository for AI agents. Paths are repo-relative.

## Core (always load)

- [Federal AI Agent Behavioral Best Practices](AGENTS.md): Best practices for AI coding agent behavior in federal development environments — includes behavioral standards, engineering discipline enforcement, and verification requirements
- [Agent Context Loading Guide](CONTEXT-GUIDE.md): Compact routing document for AI agents — read this FIRST to determine which documents to load for your current task
- [Federal AI Coding Playbook](PLAYBOOK.md): Step-by-step guide for starting a federal coding project with AI agents
- [Agent Identity, Authentication, Authorization, and Delegation](docs/AGENT-IDENTITY.md): Agent identity management aligned with NCCoE concept paper — authentication, authorization, delegation, and audit logging for AI agents
- [Agent Instructions](docs/AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md): Model-agnostic repo-specific reference for any AI coding agent working in this repository
- [Secure Coding Practices for AI-Assisted Federal Development](docs/CODING_PRACTICES.md): Secure coding standards for AI-assisted development — input validation, secrets management, dependency security, architecture discipline, change safety, SOLID principles, OWASP/SSDF alignment
- [Coding Standards — Compact Reference](docs/CODING_STANDARDS_COMPACT.md): LLM-optimized coding standards for inclusion in code generation context (~500 words)
- [NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5.2 Control Overlay for Agentic AI Systems](docs/SECURITY-CONTROLS.md): 800-53 control overlay mapping 35 security controls across 10 families to concrete AI agent behaviors and verification methods
- [Agent Context Loading Guide (Project)](templates/CONTEXT-GUIDE.project.md): Compact routing document for AI agents working in this project — read this FIRST to determine which documents to load for your current task

## Supporting

- [AI-Assisted Contribution Policy](docs/AI-CONTRIBUTION-POLICY.md): Canonical policy governing AI-assisted contributions — human accountability, disclosure, provenance, verification, data handling, security review, and licensing posture for federal AI-assisted development
- [Federal AI Landscape](docs/FEDERAL-AI-LANDSCAPE.md): Canonical catalog of federal AI guidance, executive orders, standards, and legislation relevant to AI-assisted software development
- [Getting Started: Repository Setup and Environment Hardening](docs/GETTING-STARTED.md): Step-by-step guide for setting up a development repository with security controls for AI coding agents
- [Control Traceability Matrix](docs/TRACEABILITY.md): Bidirectional mapping between NIST 800-53 controls, OWASP risks, document sections, and checklist items
- [Human-Readable Skill Title](templates/SKILL.md.template): One sentence describing what this skill does and when to use it
- [Document Title](templates/doc.md.template): One-line summary of what this document covers

## Templates & checklists

- [Pre-Deployment Security Checklist](checklists/pre-deployment.md): 62-item security checklist for deploying AI-assisted code — secrets, input validation, auth, dependencies, testing, infrastructure, accessibility
- [Prompt Injection Defense Patterns](docs/PROMPT-INJECTION-DEFENSE.md): Implementation patterns for defending against prompt injection in AI-assisted federal applications
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): Long-term plan for the Agentic Coding Playbook — making it a living resource for federal engineers learning agentic coding
- [Example: AGENTS.md for a Federal Web Application](examples/AGENTS.md.example): Completed example showing a thin, project-specific AGENTS.md layered on the universal contract for a hypothetical federal HR benefits portal

- [Project Plan](templates/PROJECT_PLAN.md): Starting point for a new federal coding project — fill this out and let the AI agent set up everything else
- [Privacy Impact Assessment for AI-Enabled Systems](templates/privacy-impact-assessment.md): PIA template for federal systems using AI components — data flows, privacy risks, mitigations, and compliance sign-off
